_comment: Everything under api/_lib is ES modules. Node decides a .js file's module type from the NEAREST package.json, and the root one deliberately has no "type" (next/*.js are classic browser scripts, and next/recommend.js is require()d by the tests). Without this file Node reparses these as ESM with a warning that tells the reader to add "type":"module" to the ROOT package.json — which would break both of those. One line here, no dependencies, nothing to install.
